# RealIRacing

> RealIRacing (realiracing.com) is an iRacing sim racing site by Carlos Martinez: practical guides on force feedback settings, wheel and pedal buyer's guides, safety rating and racecraft, car and track guides, and OBS streaming setups, plus race highlights, setup guides and rig tours on the @realtape YouTube channel. Real motorsport roots, tested on a real rig.

## About
- Author: Carlos Martinez (iRacing user "Carlos Martinez9"). Home: https://realiracing.com/
- Rig: MOZA R9 direct drive wheelbase, MOZA CS V2 wheel, MOZA CRP2 load cell pedals, RTX 5060 Ti, 1440p 120 Hz monitor. Full breakdown: https://realiracing.com/gear.html
- Affiliate disclosure: gear links go to Amazon and carry an affiliate tag; the author may earn a commission at no cost to the reader. The site does not use sponsored loaner hardware.
- 125 blog guides published so far; new posts appear several times a week.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://realiracing.com/): channel overview, content types, gear picks, FAQ
- [Blog](https://realiracing.com/blog/): all iRacing guides, settings and gear advice
- [My Rig](https://realiracing.com/gear.html): every part Carlos races and streams on, with notes on why
- [Link hub](https://realiracing.com/go/): all platforms in one place
- [YouTube @realtape](https://www.youtube.com/@realtape): race highlights, setup guides, rig tours, iRacing tips
- Social: [Instagram @realiracing](https://www.instagram.com/realiracing) · [TikTok @realiracing](https://www.tiktok.com/@realiracing) · [X @realiracing](https://x.com/realiracing)

## Latest blog posts (newest first)

- [iRacing Qualifying Best Practices: Strategy, Pace, and Grid Position](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-qualifying-best-practices-pace.html): Master iRacing qualifying with proven techniques for tire prep, fuel strategy, and consistent pace. Learn when to push and how to avoid costly mistakes.
- [Eye Strain and Screen Distance: Preventing Fatigue in Long iRacing Sessions](https://realiracing.com/blog/prevent-eye-strain-sim-racing-distance.html): How screen distance, monitor size, and viewing angles affect eye fatigue in sim racing. Real solutions I use on my rig to race injury-free for hours.
- [Cadillac V-Series.R GTP iRacing Guide: Setup and Technique](https://realiracing.com/blog/cadillac-v-series-r-gtp-iracing-guide.html): Master the Cadillac V-Series.R GTP with proven setup adjustments, brake calibration, and racecraft tactics for iRacing's top prototype class.
- [Direct Drive Damping and Friction: Finding Your Feel](https://realiracing.com/blog/direct-drive-damping-friction-settings.html): Learn how damping and friction tuning on direct drive wheels changes FFB response. I dial these on my MOZA R9 for consistency across cars and tracks.
- [iRacing Incident Points Explained: What Actually Causes Them](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-incident-points-how-they-work.html): Understand how incident points work in iRacing and what driving mistakes actually trigger penalties. Learn to protect your safety rating.
- [Zandvoort iRacing Guide: Banking, Blind Crests, and Line Choice](https://realiracing.com/blog/zandvoort-iracing-guide-banking-crests.html): Master Zandvoort's unique banking and blind-crest challenges. Learn where to brake, how to trust the banking, and why your throttle discipline matters more than your wheel.
- [Dirt Sprint Car iRacing Beginner Guide: Setup and Technique](https://realiracing.com/blog/dirt-sprint-car-iracing-beginners-guide.html): Master dirt sprint car setup and driving technique in iRacing. Learn throttle control, weight transfer, and baseline setups to go faster on clay.
- [iRacing FFB Clipping: How to Diagnose and Fix It Now](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-ffb-clipping-diagnosis-and-fixes.html): Learn to spot FFB clipping on your wheelbase, understand why it tanks feedback quality, and apply fixes that actually work.
- [Anti-Roll Bars and Balance: How ARB Stiffness Shifts Weight](https://realiracing.com/blog/anti-roll-bars-balance-shift-explained.html): Understand how anti-roll bar adjustments affect front-to-rear balance, understeer, and oversteer in iRacing without needing a setup shop.
- [Brands Hatch Grand Prix iRacing Guide: Setup, Lines, Braking](https://realiracing.com/blog/brands-hatch-grand-prix-iracing-guide.html): Master Brands Hatch's tight corners and elevation changes. Learn the racing line, brake zones, and setup tweaks that work on my MOZA R9 rig.
- [Aston Martin Vantage GT4 iRacing: Setup, Braking, and Race Craft](https://realiracing.com/blog/aston-martin-vantage-gt4-comprehensive-guide.html): Master the Vantage GT4's mid-range performance with practical setup guidance, brake calibration, and overtaking lines for consistent GT4 racing.
- [Pedal Spacing and Angle Setup for Consistent Braking](https://realiracing.com/blog/pedal-spacing-angle-consistent-braking.html): How to position your pedals for repeatable brake pressure and muscle memory. Small geometry changes create big consistency gains.
- [Building Your Own Setup From iRacing's Baseline: When and How](https://realiracing.com/blog/building-setup-from-iracing-baseline.html): Learn when to stop relying on baseline setups and start modifying for your rig, driving style, and track conditions.
- [Endurance Racing Fuel and Tire Strategy: Essential Basics](https://realiracing.com/blog/endurance-fuel-tire-strategy-basics.html): Master fuel consumption and tire degradation in long-distance iRacing. Learn stint planning, pit window timing, and tire-saving techniques for GT and prototype racing.
- [Darlington Raceway iRacing Guide: Lines, Setup, Aggression](https://realiracing.com/blog/darlington-raceway-iracing-guide.html): Master Darlington's tight oval with banking quirks and worn surface. Setup tuning, braking zones, and racecraft for consistent pace.
- [Posture and Back Pain in a Fixed Cockpit: Real Solutions](https://realiracing.com/blog/posture-back-pain-fixed-cockpit-solutions.html): Fix lower back pain and poor posture in your fixed sim rig. Practical adjustments to seat angle, wheel height, and pedal position that actually work.
- [Garage61 vs Telemetry Comparison Tools: Which Fits Your iRacing Workflow](https://realiracing.com/blog/garage61-telemetry-comparison-tools.html): Compare Garage61, iSpeed, and other telemetry tools to find the right fit for your setup analysis and lap improvement workflow.
- [iRacing Protest and Sporting Code: The Complete Process](https://realiracing.com/blog/iracing-protest-sporting-code-process.html): Understand when to protest, how iRacing investigates incidents, and what the sporting code means for your account and iRating.
- [Okayama International Circuit iRacing Guide: Setup and Technique](https://realiracing.com/blog/okayama-iracing-guide.html): Master Okayama's tight corners and heavy braking zones. Learn the setup, line, and throttle discipline needed to be quick on iRacing's technical Japanese circuit.
- [Used Sim Racing Wheelbase Buying Guide: What to Check First](https://realiracing.com/blog/used-sim-racing-wheelbase-buying-guide.html): How to inspect a used direct-drive or belt-drive wheelbase for wear, motor health, and hidden damage before you buy.
